nonUserActors.authorityRule: AI has no independent user role, membership, ownership, entitlement, or visibility authority and receives only a narrower projection derived from the initiating subject.

contractOwnership.name: Stable subject identity
contractOwnership.rule: Provider identities, email, display names, devices, and current roles never replace subjectId.

contractOwnership.name: Authentication session
contractOwnership.rule: Authentication proves a session subject but does not itself grant Campaign, role, object, or support access.

contractOwnership.name: Role and membership separation
contractOwnership.rule: Membership, role, Character control, ownership, custody, entitlement, and delegation are separate versioned decisions.

contractOwnership.name: Selected-context receipt
contractOwnership.rule: The receipt preserves navigation and recovery context but is nonauthoritative and must be revalidated on entry and mutation.

contractOwnership.name: Default authorization decision
contractOwnership.rule: Unknown, incomplete, stale, or unavailable policy inputs fail closed.

contractOwnership.name: Field-safe projection
contractOwnership.rule: Unauthorized fields, relationships, counts, labels, and payloads never reach ordinary client state.

contractOwnership.name: Safe non-disclosure response
contractOwnership.rule: Use not-found-or-unavailable behavior where a precise denial would reveal protected existence.

contractOwnership.name: Object query and ranking
contractOwnership.rule: Authorization and entitlement filtering occurs before ranking, pagination, facets, counts, suggestions, comparison, and serialization.

contractOwnership.name: Object selection receipt
contractOwnership.rule: Selection returns stable identity and compatibility evidence; the caller performs domain validation before authoritative mutation.

contractOwnership.name: Local draft
contractOwnership.rule: A local draft and autosave receipt are nonauthoritative convenience state.

contractOwnership.name: Authoritative save and command
contractOwnership.rule: Authoritative mutation requires online service validation, expected version, idempotency, current authorization, and durable receipt or Event.

contractOwnership.name: Ambiguous failure lookup
contractOwnership.rule: After a lost response, query status by stable operation or command ID before retrying with a new identity.

contractOwnership.name: Realtime and event recovery
contractOwnership.rule: Realtime is advisory; ordered durable Events and current server projections control recovery.

contractOwnership.name: Revocation invalidation
contractOwnership.rule: Revocation ends subscriptions, invalidates context receipts, removes protected cards and counts, and clears or partitions protected caches.

contractOwnership.name: Bounded offline use
contractOwnership.rule: Offline supports manifest-bound authorized reading and approved local drafts only; no offline authoritative mutation is permitted.

contractOwnership.name: Release identity
contractOwnership.rule: Every issue and diagnostic bundle binds to exact release, build, commit, environment, schema, migration, pack-set, and support-policy identity.

contractOwnership.name: Diagnostic manifest
contractOwnership.rule: Diagnostics default to exclude, use allowlisted safe fields, redact before preview, and require explicit consent before attachment.

contractOwnership.name: Issue submission
contractOwnership.rule: Issue drafts are local until submitted; submission is idempotent and returns a stable receipt or portable export.

contractOwnership.name: Support access
contractOwnership.rule: An issue report never grants content access; protected support access requires separate purpose, scope, approval, attribution, and expiry.

contractOwnership.name: Protected attachments
contractOwnership.rule: Attachments require explicit selection, preview, removal, classification, quarantine, checksum, scoped retrieval, and revocation handling.

contractOwnership.name: Accessibility state equivalence
contractOwnership.rule: Loading, empty, forbidden, stale, conflict, offline, reconnect, recovery, and success states are exposed through semantic, keyboard, screen-reader, touch, zoom, reduced-motion, and noncolor behavior.

contractOwnership.name: Responsive context preservation
contractOwnership.rule: Desktop, tablet, and mobile may change layout but not authority, available evidence, recovery semantics, or required actions.

contractOwnership.name: Provider-neutral ports
contractOwnership.rule: Provider SDKs and identifiers remain inside adapters; core contracts remain portable and testable with local deterministic adapters.

contractOwnership.name: Zero-service core path
contractOwnership.rule: Core internal-alpha design must operate without paid search, identity, analytics, crash reporting, ticketing, notification, or AI services.

integrationJourneys.name: Authorized workspace to object selection and save
steps: inspect and select stable object ID

integrationJourneys.name: Revocation during an open workflow
steps: preserve only permitted local draft metadata

integrationJourneys.name: Offline draft and reconnect
steps: revalidate permission entitlement pack schema and versions

integrationJourneys.name: Support follow-up without implicit access
steps: authorized support actor opens assigned report projection
obtain separate support-access approval when protected content is necessary

resolvedFindings.resolution: Canonical persisted role IDs use lowercase hyphenated values; display labels remain localized presentation.
AI is an optional assistive service actor, not a user role and not an independent source of authority.
permissionVersion is canonical; permissionsVersion is a documented input alias requiring normalization at the boundary.
entitlementVersion is canonical; entitlementRulesetVersion is a documented input alias requiring normalization at the boundary.
game-session is the canonical workspace type, sessionId is the canonical identifier, and Session remains a display label.
Issue ownership or assignment never grants Campaign, Character, Scene, Session, private-note, or GM-truth access.
Client caches, local drafts, realtime messages, selected-context receipts, and offline snapshots remain nonauthoritative.
All reviewed shared foundations retain a zero-paid-service and zero-AI core path.
